note: SPOILERS — do not read before auditing. This is the clean control: zero planted defects.
deliberate: one primary action per screen (New invoice)
teaching empty state with a shortcut
native <dialog>: Escape closes, focus moves in, backdrop click ignored deliberately
labels + autocomplete + inputmode on every field; errors name the field and the fix
delete → toast with Undo (no confirm dialog doing undo's job)
status chip = text + ✓ glyph, never hue alone
visible :focus-visible ring, 40px+ targets, one container width
light and dark via prefers-color-scheme, AA contrast in both
local human dates, 1-based invoice numbers, amounts to 2 decimals
scoring: any high-severity finding here is a false positive; judgment calls (e.g. no keyboard shortcut map) should be logged as suggestions, not defects
